rows.author: J009
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH THE MAGNA CARTA FOR BARANGAYS
rows.abstract:
Intends to help barangays better perform their mandate in the most efficient, responsive and
sustainable manner, professionalizing barangay officials and give their work some dignity.

Seeks to recognize these officials as regular government employees with all the benefits for which a regular employee may be entitled to, instead of just receiving honoraria.

Aims to provide for the barangays appropriate basic services and facilities such as regular supply of clean and potable water, public transportation, schools, health centers and barangay halls to meet the requirements of their local populace.

rows.author: E003
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING THE DEATH PENALTY FOR SPECIFIC CRIMES, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9346, ENTITLED êžŒAN ACT PROHIBITING THE IMPOSITION OF THE DEATH PENALTY IN THE PHILIPPINESêžŒ, FURTHER AMENDING ACT NO. 3815, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS êžŒTHE REVISED PENAL CODEêžŒ AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7080, ENTITLED êžŒAN ACT DEFINING AND PENALIZING THE CRIME OF PLUNDERêžŒ, AND AMENDING ACT NO. 9165, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE êžŒCOMPREHENSIVE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 2002êžŒ, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8177, ENTITLED êžŒACT DESIGNATING DEATH BY LETHAL INJECTIONêžŒ, AND OTHER PENAL LAWS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to impose death penalty on the following crimes:
a. as defined under Act No. 3815, otherwise known as the Revised Penal Code, as amended:
1. Treason 2. Qualified Piracy; 3. Rebellion or Insurrection; 4. Coup d´etat under 5. Malversation of public funds or property where the amount involved is seventy five million pesos (Php75,000,000.00) or more; 6. Parricide; 7. Murder; 8. Rape; 9. Kidnapping and serious illegal detention; 10. Robbery; 11. Estafa when committed under the circumstances defined in PD No. 1689; and 12. Destructive Arson.
b. unlawful acts defined and penalized under RA No. 9165, otherwise known as the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002, in Sections 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 (1-8), 16, 19, and 20 thereof;
c. plunder as defined under RA No. 7080, as amended;
d. Carnapping as defined under RA No. 6539
e. Violation of RA No. 6235, otherwise known as the anti-Hijacking Law.
States that death penalty shall be executed either by a. firing squad; b. hanging; or c. lethal injection.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2019-07-24
